section: Information technology and e-governance in Andhra Pradesh - IT policy, RTGS, e-Pragati
subsections: AP IT and electronics policies - period, targets, fiscal incentives
AP data centre and AI initiatives - AI hub city, Google data centre, Quantum Valley

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs relating to Andhra Pradesh policies:
a. Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0 — 2024-29
b. IT & GCC Policy 4.0 — 2024-29
c. Data Center Policy 4.0 — 2024-29
d. LIFT Policy 4.0 — 2025-29
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: The Electronics Manufacturing, IT & GCC and Data Center Policies 4.0 cover 2024-29. The LIFT Policy 4.0 also covers 2024-29, not 2025-29.
accepted.tq: Find the one altered policy period among otherwise correctly matched pairs.
accepted.sec: AP IT and electronics policies - period, targets, fiscal incentives  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The target fixed under the Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0 of Andhra Pradesh for production is:
accepted.x: The Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0 targets electronics production of US$50 billion, equivalent to approximately ₹4.2 lakh crore.
accepted.tq: Use the policy target table to distinguish production from investment figures.
accepted.sec: AP IT and electronics policies - period, targets, fiscal incentives  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The investment target under the Andhra Pradesh Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0 is approximately:
accepted.x: The policy targets investment of US$10 billion, equivalent to approximately ₹84,000 crore.
accepted.tq: Separate the investment target from the larger production target.
accepted.sec: AP IT and electronics policies - period, targets, fiscal incentives  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the correct target of the Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0 of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Creation of 10 lakh permanent government jobs
accepted.x: The policy targets 5 lakh first-time employment opportunities. Creation of 2 lakh first-time entrepreneurs is not its target.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the precise employment target from the similar-sounding entrepreneurship figure.
accepted.sec: AP IT and electronics policies - period, targets, fiscal incentives  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following sets contains the approaches specifically associated with the Electronics Manufacturing Policy 4.0 of Andhra Pradesh?
1. Electronics Manufacturing Clusters
2. Special Economic Zones
3. Plug-and-play parks
4. Fifty Centres of Excellence
accepted.x: The policy promotes EMCs, SEZs, plug-and-play parks and 50 Centres of Excellence. It also envisages training 5 lakh workers.
accepted.tq: Recognise the option containing the complete policy approach rather than a partial list.
accepted.sec: AP IT and electronics policies - period, targets, fiscal incentives  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the IT & GCC Policy 4.0 of Andhra Pradesh:
1. It provides for capital subsidies.
2. It includes tax exemptions and employment-linked incentives.
3. It focuses on IT parks, co-working spaces and neighbourhood workspaces.
4. It covers emerging areas such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing and cyber technology.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements describe provisions or focus areas of the IT & GCC Policy 4.0 for 2024-29.
accepted.tq: Use the complete-policy option when all listed incentives, workspaces and technology areas belong together.
accepted.sec: AP IT and electronics policies - period, targets, fiscal incentives  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Policy)
 a. Data Center Policy 4.0
 b. LIFT Policy 4.0
 c. Electronics Components Manufacturing Policy
 d. ESDM Policy

List-II (Feature)
 i. Component ecosystem
 ii. Land incentives for GCCs and IT infrastructure developers
 iii. Zone A/B reimbursement incentives
 iv. Addition of up to 1 GW data-centre capacity

Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
accepted.x: The Data Center Policy targets up to 1 GW additional capacity; LIFT offers land incentives; the Components Policy develops the component ecosystem; and the ESDM Policy provides Zone A/B reimbursement incentives.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure policy-feature pairs and eliminate codes with swapped incentives.
accepted.sec: AP IT and electronics policies - period, targets, fiscal incentives  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Under the Zone A/B incentive of the Andhra Pradesh ESDM Policy, which of the following are reimbursed at 100 per cent?
1. Stamp duty
2. Transfer duty
3. Registration fee
4. Income tax
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The ESDM Policy 2021-24 provides 100 per cent reimbursement of stamp duty, transfer duty and registration fee in the Zone A/B incentive. Income tax is not included in this stated incentive.
accepted.tq: Identify the three specified fiscal charges and reject the neighbouring tax term.
accepted.sec: AP IT and electronics policies - period, targets, fiscal incentives  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about incentives for electronics component makers in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
o: They are limited to income-tax refunds.
They are restricted to software-export companies.
They include advance and matching incentives, interim support and plug-and-play facilities.
They provide only land allotment without financial support.
accepted.x: The stated support for component makers consists of advance and matching incentives, interim support and plug-and-play facilities.
accepted.tq: Prefer the option listing the complete combination of incentives rather than an exclusive single benefit.
accepted.sec: AP IT and electronics policies - period, targets, fiscal incentives  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The AP Cyber Security Operations Centre (APCSOC) was set up at which place on 23 April 2018?
accepted.x: The AP Cyber Security Operations Centre was set up at Vijayawada on 23 April 2018 under the framework associated with the AP Cyber Security Policy 2017.
accepted.tq: Match the specific cyber-security institution with its location and date.
accepted.sec: AP IT and electronics policies - period, targets, fiscal incentives  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The first unit cleared under the ISM framework in the context of Andhra Pradesh's semiconductor initiatives was an OSAT unit proposed by:
accepted.x: The first ISM-framework unit cleared was an OSAT project by Advanced System in Package Technologies, with an investment of ₹2,388 crore at Tarluvada, Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Use the company-project association to distinguish the semiconductor unit from data-centre companies.
accepted.sec: AP IT and electronics policies - period, targets, fiscal incentives  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The OSAT unit cleared under the ISM framework in Andhra Pradesh is associated with which investment and location?
accepted.x: The OSAT unit of Advanced System in Package Technologies involves ₹2,388 crore and is located at Tarluvada in Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Pair the exact investment figure with the project location rather than a nearby cluster figure.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Google AI data-centre project in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Its foundation stone was laid on 28 April 2026.
2. The project is located at Tarluvada.
3. It is being implemented through Google's subsidiary Raiden Infotech with AdaniConneX and Airtel Nxtra.
4. Its proposed investment is ₹1.35 lakh crore.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements describe the Google AI data-centre project: foundation stone laying on 28 April 2026, Tarluvada location, the participating entities and the proposed ₹1.35 lakh crore investment.
accepted.tq: Check the date, site, implementing entities and investment figure together to identify the complete description.
accepted.sec: AP data centre and AI initiatives - AI hub city, Google data centre, Quantum Valley  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Google AI data-centre project in Andhra Pradesh is scheduled for inauguration on:
accepted.x: The inauguration of the Google AI data-centre project is scheduled for 28 September 2028. 28 April 2026 was the date on which its foundation stone was laid.
accepted.tq: Separate the foundation-stone date from the scheduled inauguration date.
accepted.sec: AP data centre and AI initiatives - AI hub city, Google data centre, Quantum Valley  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: AI data-centre cluster — Adani Infra — 1,000 MW and 601.4 acres
Hyperscale cluster and GCC Park — RMZ — up to 1 GW
Data-centre ecosystem — APCRDA — 1 GW in Amaravati
Google AI hub — 1 GW — Tarluvada, Adavivaram and Rambilli
accepted.x: The APCRDA data-centre ecosystem in Amaravati has a target of 9 GW, not 1 GW. The other three project-capacity-location associations are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the altered capacity figure in a correctly structured project-location match.
accepted.sec: AP data centre and AI initiatives - AI hub city, Google data centre, Quantum Valley  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following Andhra Pradesh technology clusters according to their stated locations:
A. Data & AI City
B. Quantum Valley
C. Green Hydrogen cluster
D. Drone City
Which of the following is the correct location sequence?
accepted.x: Data & AI City is at Visakhapatnam, Quantum Valley at Amaravati, the Green Hydrogen cluster at Kakinada and Drone City at Orvakal in Kurnool.
accepted.tq: Use the location sequence to eliminate options with swapped technology clusters.
accepted.sec: AP data centre and AI initiatives - AI hub city, Google data centre, Quantum Valley  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding Amaravati Quantum Valley is correct?
1. It is described as India's first Quantum Valley.
2. It functions under the National Quantum Mission.
3. Its areas of work include quantum computing, QKD and post-quantum cryptography.
4. Firms located there receive 100 per cent exemption from stamp duty and registration fee.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Amaravati Quantum Valley is linked with the National Quantum Mission, works in the specified quantum fields and has been granted full exemption from stamp duty and registration fee for eligible firms.
accepted.tq: Use the all-inclusive option when the identity, institutional framework, activities and incentive are all correct.

1. Drone City is located at Orvakal in Kurnool district.
2. The Drone City project covers 600 acres.
3. Its foundation stone was laid in November 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?

accepted.s:
With reference to Andhra Pradesh's data-centre policies, consider the following statements:
1. Andhra Pradesh Data Center Policy 4.0 targets up to 1 GW of additional capacity during 2024-29.
2. Gujarat Data Centre Policy 2026-29 targets 7.5 GW.
3. Andhra Pradesh's target is higher than Gujarat's target.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh targets up to 1 GW of additional data-centre capacity, while Gujarat targets 7.5 GW. Therefore, the Andhra Pradesh target is not higher than Gujarat's.
accepted.tq: Check both numerical targets before accepting the reversed comparison.

accepted.x: Visakhapatnam is described as India's third international subsea cable landing station, after Mumbai and Chennai.
accepted.tq: Use the stated ordinal position and the two preceding locations to identify the answer.
